notes.title: Speed-running and Claiming World Records in Dodge If you Can!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Happy Halloween, Champions and Legends!
[/b][/h1]

With the recent Major Update, [b]FIVE ALL-NEW[/b] Legendary Levels have been released, forcing you to go head-on against High-IQ Turrets, during which you must reach a new designed Safe Zone.

As tough as it is, will you, fellow Champions and Legends, be able to Speed-run all the Levels including the last [b]FIVE ALL-NEW[/b] Legendary Levels without a problem? Will you give up? Will you persevere? 

For these questions, you must answer with haste!

You're interested! You're adventurous! You're motivated to beat this challenge!

To show your potential and proof, upload a YouTube video with the tag "#dodgeifyoucan" to flex your Speed-run World Record!

Now! Champions and Legends! Will your strategy and wits prevail among the storm of bullets? Will you go down as a legend? Only you can decide. Now - Dodge, If you Can!

Congratulations to the user, 'Tyloris' who managed to beat the Levels including the Legendary Levels in all under 4 minutes and 19.55 seconds!

[previewyoutube=quzX1uKXFO0;full][/previewyoutube]
